invariants.rationale: The method always returns 'this', which cannot be null.
The method returns 'this' per the code.
At exit, the 'rotation' field of 'this' has been set to the parameter 'rotation'.
'result' is 'this', whose 'rotation' was just set to the input parameter.
'result' and 'this' refer to the same object, so their 'rotation' fields are equal.
